ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is a contour topographic map of a certain island. The north arrow in the upper right corner shows that the upper side is north, so the right side of the figure is east. Among the four places, ① is located in the southwestern part of the island, near a group of relatively dense closed contours, with a relatively high elevation; ② is in a low place near the coast in the northwestern part of the island; ③ is in the central-southern part of the island, and on its eastern side there is still relatively high or continuous contour terrain; ④ is near the coast on the eastern side of the island and is relatively low. Reasoning: September 20 is close to the autumnal equinox, and in the Fujian 26°N region, the sunrise direction is roughly near due east. When observing sunrise on an island, the main comparison is the elevation of the place and the eastern view: places with high elevation and no obstruction or less obstruction on the eastern side can see the sun earlier. ① has a relatively high elevation, and there is no obvious higher continuous ridge blocking the direction from it eastward to the sea; ② and ④ have low elevations, and ③ is affected by terrain obstruction on the eastern side. Therefore, among the four places, the earliest place to observe sunrise is ①.

method.method_draft: 先读图：确认指北针向上，因此图右为东；四个标号中，①位于岛西南部一组密集闭合等高线内，海拔较高，且其东侧到海面方向没有比它更高的连续山脊遮挡；②、④靠近海岸低处，③虽在中部但东侧仍有较高等高线地形。再读文字：地点在福建26°N，日期9月20日，接近秋分，日出方向大致在正东附近。桥接规则：海岛上观测日出，主要比较面向东方的视野和海拔高度；海拔越高、东侧遮挡越少，越早看见太阳。按此比较四点，①海拔高且东向视野较好，因此最早观测到日出，填1。
